messages:
Marta (partnerships): Heads-up: EU marketplace windows overlap with H200 & MI300 partner launches. Need to lock cert image names, KMS/HSM key tags for private deployments, and legal embargo clauses by EOD CET.

Liam (cloud-partners): Which cloud regions are we prioritizing for simultaneous listing? FR, DE, NL preferred by partners. Cloud partners require 7 business days for listing review.

Omar (eng-ops): Build pipeline can produce EU signed images, but HSM integration needs the key rotation window. If legal needs longer hold, we can stamp image with hold flag.

Sophie (legal): We need the partner NDA release times and whether partners want a rolling embargo (per-region) or a global window. Rolling is safer for supply variance.

AMD_ops: MI300 SKU readiness: most boards cleared QA, two vendor BIOS fixes pending that may ship 2026-04-04. If BIOS not in, we should mark MI300 as "US/EU phased" in the listing.

HPE_vendor: For on-prem packages we will require the KMS alias tag: redwood-gaudi-eu-prod. Also confirm HPE firmware baseline: 3.2.1 or later.

Marta (partnerships): Proposed marketplace metadata snippet (please review):

```
marketplace_metadata:
  name: mi300.dedicated.eu
  image_tag: mi300-prod-image:v1.0
  kms_alias: redwood-mi300-eu-prod
  firmware: bios-3.2.1
  embargo: 2026-04-15T08:00:00Z
```

Liam (cloud-partners): Cloud marketplaces will reject names with capital letters or extra dots. Use hyphens only. Also they want a short compliance note for EU data residency.

Omar (eng-ops): Confirmed: our image signing process will add the HSM signature and a checksum file. We can include the checksum link in the listing metadata.

marketplace-bot: Validation check -> name format ok; kms alias length ok; checksum present? NO. Please attach checksum file before publish.

Sophie (legal): On embargo: partners often request a 24h pre-announce partner-only window. If we grant that, we need to define an exception list and sign-off workflow. Recommended: partner-only window = 24h, partner list in shared doc.

AMD_ops: We'll push BIOS fixes to QA by 2026-04-03. If QA passes, final image ready 2026-04-06 UTC.

Marta (partnerships): Two risk scenarios for announce sequencing:
- green: both H200 and MI300 images signed + checksums uploaded by 2026-04-06 -> announce 2026-04-15 global
- amber: MI300 delayed -> announce H200 global, MI300 phased EU/US with clear listing notes
- red: BIOS or KMS delay -> hold public announce, partner-only notices as appropriate

Omar (eng-ops): Ops checklist for SI / on-prem: include required KMS alias, firmware baseline, and checksum verification step. Paste for runbook: 

```
# SI verification steps
verify-checksum --image mi300-prod-image:v1.0 --checksum-url=https://s3.redwood.example/mi300/v1.0.sha256
verify-firmware --host=target --min-version=3.2.1
set-kms-alias --alias=redwood-mi300-eu-prod
```

HPE_vendor: We'll confirm firmware baseline for HPE nodes today and share part numbers.

Liam (cloud-partners): Marketplace timing note: listing review + security scan = 5-7 business days in EU. If we want 2026-04-15 announce, all artifacts must be uploaded by 2026-04-08 EOB CET.

Sophie (legal): I'll prepare partner-only window agreement template and the exception approval flow. Will post draft in doc by EOD CET.

Marta (partnerships): Action items: @AMD_ops upload checksum & final image by 2026-04-06 UTC; @HPE_vendor confirm firmware/part numbers today; @Liam ensure listing constraints doc circulated; @Sophie draft partner-window NDA template by EOD CET. Reconvene Thu 09:00 CET if blockers. Thanks :party_popper:
